paragraphs.text: Four locations in Pontotoc and one in Ecru are accepting new, unwrapped toys through Tuesday, Dec. 15. The local Marine Toys for Tots campaign serves children in Pontotoc and Union counties. Its deadline for families to request toys was Nov. 15.

Two of the boxes are on Highway 15 North in Pontotoc. First Choice Bank has one at 236 Highway 15 North, and Guaranty Bank has one at 1882 Highway 15 North. Donors can also leave toys at Montgomery’s On Main, 17 South Main St., or at Amazing Touch Hair Design, 329 Clark St.

In Ecru, the collection box is at Ecru Second Baptist Church, 350 Central Ave. The campaign lists a different location for families picking up toys. Distribution runs from 2 to 5 p.m. Sunday, Dec. 20, at the Tupelo Police Athletic League, 204 Douglas St. in Tupelo. Organizers say toys will be available for pickup only during that window.

Schools, workplaces and community groups can organize toy drives, and the campaign is seeking volunteers to sort and distribute donations. Coordinator Katina Tucker lists pontotoc.ms@toysfortots.org for questions. The local campaign reports that it distributed 2,233 toys and served 737 children in 2025.
